t: Founded by Roger II in 1130, it joined Sicily and southern Italy in one of medieval Europe’s most centralised states.
Its Norman court mixed Latin, Greek and Arabic government and art, seen in Palermo, Cefalù and Monreale.
After the Vespers of 1282 it survived as an island kingdom under Aragon, Spain and others until 1816.
dyk: From 1530 the Knights Hospitaller held Malta as a fief of the kingdom, paying the king of Sicily an annual tribute of a single falcon.
ev: Roger II is crowned king of Sicily in Palermo
Al-Idrisi completes his world geography, the Book of Roger
Henry VI conquers the kingdom, bringing the Hohenstaufen to the throne
Frederick II issues the Constitutions of Melfi
Charles of Anjou defeats Manfred at Benevento
The Sicilian Vespers drive the Angevins from the island
The Treaty of Utrecht gives Sicily to Victor Amadeus II of Savoy
Sicily and Naples are merged into the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies

f.predecessor: County of Sicily; Duchy of Apulia and Calabria
